description:
📺 Watch full episode: https://youtu.be/Q_RNiXla_6s
🏳️‍🌈 Wicked - What no one is talking about...: https://youtu.be/NrtBdKX5kKg
🔮 Ariana Grande says she's a real life witch: https://youtu.be/sy91jSzRBZI

Wicked isn’t just a musical or movie—it’s a carefully crafted celebration of occult philosophy, inspired by figures like Satanist Aleister Crowley and worshipper of Lucifer, Helena Blavatsky.

In this video, we expose how Wicked draws from the very teachings that shaped modern-day witchcraft, Theosophy, and ceremonial magic. We unpack the appearance of the Lesser Key of Solomon in Wicked, a book full of sigils to call up demons. We discuss the spiritualists, the Fox sisters, and many other occult origins of Wicked that so many parents watch with their children as a family get-together.
